dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pyqf](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pyqf) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on May 11 2025 75km S of Pangai. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -20.4717 longitude -174.2203. It impacted 17 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
